categories.main_business_segments: Formosa Petrochemical Corporation primarily operates in petroleum refining, petrochemical raw materials production, and utility services. Its main products include gasoline, diesel, aviation fuel, fuel oil, liquefied petroleum gas, ethylene, propylene, butadiene, and basic petrochemical raw materials. The company also engages in storage and transportation of petroleum and petrochemical products, as well as cargo handling at its dedicated industrial port.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced international refining and light oil cracking technologies, including hydrodesulfurization and catalytic processes to produce low-sulfur fuels meeting stringent environmental standards. It integrates AI and digital transformation to optimize production efficiency and product quality. The firm also focuses on energy-saving, emission reduction, and circular economy initiatives, including sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) production certified by ISCC CORSIA.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic downstream petrochemical companies within the Formosa Plastics Group, other industrial users, and international buyers in Asia, North America, Europe, and emerging markets. The company serves gasoline and diesel retail markets through its own and franchise gas stations, and exports refined products and petrochemical raw materials to regions such as Southeast Asia, Northeast Asia, Australia, the Middle East, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan, especially the Mailiao Industrial Park with integrated refining and petrochemical facilities. The company exports products globally, with significant markets in East and Southeast Asia, North America, Europe, and emerging regions including Africa and Latin America. It also operates subsidiaries and investments in the United States and Liberia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Formosa Petrochemical operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the petrochemical supply chain, including crude oil refining, production of basic petrochemical raw materials, and utility supply. It also engages in downstream activities such as product sales, storage, transportation, and port cargo handling, integrating vertically within the Formosa Plastics Group.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustainable development, focusing on AI-driven smart factory initiatives, energy efficiency, carbon reduction, and digital transformation. It invests in developing low-carbon products, including sustainable aviation fuel, and improving production flexibility to adapt to market changes. R&D efforts emphasize process optimization, catalyst development, and environmental compliance to enhance competitiveness and meet global standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of refined petroleum products, petrochemical raw materials, and utilities (electricity and steam). The company also earns income from storage, transportation, and port services. Sales are made to both domestic industrial customers and international markets, with a mix of contract-based and spot sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Formosa Petrochemical is one of Taiwan's largest refining and petrochemical companies, competing mainly with Taiwan's CPC Corporation in refining and petrochemical sectors. It holds a significant market share domestically and maintains competitive positioning through advanced technology, vertical integration, and diversified product offerings. The company faces competition from regional producers in China, Southeast Asia, and global suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$664 billion in 2024, with a decline of 6.8% compared to the previous year, reflecting challenging market conditions. Net profit after tax was NT$5.8 billion, down 73.4% year-over-year. Total assets stood at NT$371 billion, with a stable capital base of about NT$95 billion. The firm continues to invest in capital improvements and sustainability projects, aiming for steady long-term growth despite short-term market volatility.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Formosa Petrochemical emphasizes high-quality, environmentally compliant products with advanced low-sulfur fuel formulations and sustainable aviation fuel offerings. Its integrated production system and proximity to a deep-water port enable cost-effective supply and logistics. The company leverages AI and digital technologies to optimize production and reduce costs, while its commitment to ESG and sustainability enhances its corporate reputation and market appeal.
